newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Four killed in Belgrade cafe shooting.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in Belgrade cafe shooting.

text.p: Four people were killed and three wounded in a shooting attack on a cafe in the Yugoslav capital Belgrade early on Tuesday, the official news agency Tanjug reported.
It said shots were fired through the window of the suburban cafe at 3.30 a.m. (0230) on the Serbian Orthodox New Year's Day.
Tanjug said Milos Stankovic, 24, Mile Stanic, 19, Aleksandar Matovic, 31, and Srdjan Jaksic, 24, were killed in the ambush, whose motive was not immediately clear.
Eleven people were injured in a crush at a New Year rally by more than 300,000 opposition supporters in central Belgrade's Republic Square, local authorities said.
